pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are sub-polygonal with smoothed, non-angular edges. Pixel gradients at patch boundaries are soft rather than sharp. Relative spatial area of patches is highest on the mid-flank and decreases toward the visible lower limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative space forms a continuous network of off-white pathways. Junction nodes are primarily three-way intersections. Pathways maintain a narrow, consistent pixel thickness across the torso.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized, dark vertical linear marking is visible on the mid-lateral flank, representing a textural disruption or temporal mark.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, dark-colored non-anatomical feature is visible perched on the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck, consistent with a commensal bird.
